summary: BMO filed a Form 6-K with its third-quarter 2026 earnings release. The report covers net income of $1,750 million, down 25% year-over-year, partly due to a goodwill impairment charge related to the announced sale of its Transportation and Vendor Finance businesses. Adjusted net income rose 19% to $2,859 million. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure, not a special-situation event. No deal terms or transaction details are provided. Watch for future filings regarding the announced divestiture, but this filing itself is not a special situation.
